taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Android effective cleartext and trust-anchor policy by build/domain
controls.source_trace: Resolve which domain/build policy the real client uses, including custom trust managers that bypass declarative configuration.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve build variant, target SDK, domain-config inheritance, debug overrides and the network stack actually making the request. Native or third-party clients may not honor the XML policy. A debug trust anchor is not a release weakness without release applicability; show effective cleartext/peer acceptance with an owned endpoint and the real client path.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an emulator and owned local endpoint with synthetic data; compare expected TLS validation and an intentionally invalid test certificate.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A debug-only trust anchor is not a release flaw; an HTTP string unused by the application is not sensitive cleartext transmission.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply correct release/domain trust policy and retest actual client validation and legitimate TLS.
